# synthetic fixture mimicking npm-config help (npm is Artistic-2.0;
# format reproduced by hand, no verbatim capture — see ../NOTICE.md)
Sets the config fields

Usage:
jym-npm config set <key> <value>
jym-npm config get [<key>]
jym-npm config delete <key>
jym-npm config list
jym-npm config edit
jym-npm config fix

Options:
[--global]

Run "jym-npm help config" for more info
